name: Capitalism Plus
description: 44 cards from your paper prototype. Draw, trade, and play your way.

cards.name: Balanced Diet
cards.text: Discard your hand and draw out of the discard pile for the rest of when this friend is in the land of the living.

cards.name: Auction
cards.text: Force someone to sell their cards for a payment they will accept in the game.

cards.name: Recycle Diver
cards.text: Steal 2 cards from the discard pile.

cards.name: Disarm
cards.text: Play without your thumbs or give your hand away.

cards.name: Lizard Pal
cards.text: Block a targeted card or steal 2 cards.

cards.name: Crying Always Works
cards.text: Make all other friends your friends.

cards.name: Lester the Jester
cards.text: 1 steal / 2 steals. You can steal a friend or item twice.

cards.name: Vegas
cards.text: If you have over 4 cards in your hand, put your hand shuffled into the draw pile. Draw 5 cards.

cards.name: Ten Hens
cards.text: Draw an additional card on your turn.

cards.name: Taxor Taxer
cards.text: Steal 1 card from someone.

cards.name: Pain Brain
cards.text: Discard a card. Draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Jump the Gun
cards.text: Steal 2 cards from the draw pile.

cards.name: Positivity
cards.text: Smile forever or discard a card.

cards.name: The Ring King
cards.text: 1 / used. Once in the game, you can discard your hand and draw up to cards discarded.

cards.name: Donations
cards.text: When you draw additional cards, steal a card.

cards.name: Over My Dead Body
cards.text: You cannot be stolen from. If someone tries to steal, instead you discard a card.

cards.name: Suggestions
cards.text: Force someone to do any possible action once.

cards.name: Confuse
cards.text: Force someone to discard a friend or item.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.text: If someone makes you discard a card instead discard this friend and draw a card.

cards.name: Stem Cell
cards.text: Look at an opponent’s hand. Steal a card from them.

cards.name: Wizard Vonblizzard
cards.text: Draw a card when a marked card is activated.

cards.name: The Queen of 3s
cards.text: 3 / 2 / 1. After being forced to discard 3 times all opponents discard 3 cards.

cards.name: Night Knight
cards.text: Under 5 / 5 or more. If you have under 5 cards in your hand, you can choose to reroll when drawing at turn start.

cards.name: Leaf Thief
cards.text: 1 block / 2 blocks. Block 2 accusations of stealing. Replenish blocks when you discard all of your cards.

cards.name: Cookie Jar
cards.text: Counts as 2 cards when active.

cards.name: Flowers
cards.text: Take a card from the draw pile & the discard pile.

cards.name: Nope
cards.text: Block an action.

cards.name: Give and Take
cards.text: Swap hands with someone.

cards.name: Take Them Down With You
cards.text: Force someone to go down to 2 cards. You go down to 3 cards.

cards.name: Fair & Square
cards.text: Steal a card from all opponents. Shuffle this card into the draw pile.

cards.name: Money
cards.text: Draw cards up to a number people can agree on. Put this card back in your hand.

cards.name: Snake Oil
cards.text: If you successfully give this card to someone, they discard 3/4 of their hand and this card.

cards.name: Crown
cards.text: Discard 2 cards in someone’s hand. You discard 1 card.

cards.name: Vice Versa
cards.text: Force someone to discard a card. You draw a card.

cards.name: Private Investigation
cards.text: Spy on someone’s hand.

cards.name: Rumors
cards.text: Force someone to discard all friend cards in their hand.

cards.name: Hand It Over
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Almost
cards.text: Draw 4 cards. You cannot win this turn.

cards.name: Ignore
cards.text: Draw up to cards discarded from another card.

cards.name: Split
cards.text: Steal a card from both the draw & discard pile.

cards.name: Italy
cards.text: Look at the top 3 cards in the draw pile. Put one in your hand.

cards.name: Kindness of My Heart
cards.text: Steal 3 cards. Next turn, give one back.

cards.name: Too Rich
cards.text: Draw up to 4 cards when this is played. You must discard a card when you draw a card.

cards.name: Heist
cards.text: Take as many cards from anywhere as you can.
